svg.title: D65: A board packed to ship, compared with a board in an anti-static bag only
svg.desc: D65 is a cross-section, drawn to scale. Left, marked good: a 100 mm board 1.6 mm thick with parts on top is wrapped in pink anti-static bubble wrap, then sealed in a metallized static-shielding bag folded over and taped, in a corrugated box with filler. A spark from outside stops at the shielding bag. Right, marked avoid: the same board in a pink anti-static bag only; the spark passes through the bag to the board.

g.text: Good: bubble wrap inside a sealed shielding bag
Avoid: pink anti-static bag on its own
Assembled board, 100 mm long and 1.6 mm thick
Pink anti-static bubble wrap, safe against the board
Low-charging, but it does not shield
Stops a discharge from outside, but only while closed
Top folded over and taped shut
A discharge from outside passes straight through
Drawn to scale. The bags are drawn thicker than they are, so they can be seen.
